tests.name: Logger module silences non-error output in production
tests.expected: In production build, console.log/warn/debug/info calls via logger produce no output. logger.error still outputs to console.

tests.name: Desktop app starts without console.* calls outside logger/tests
tests.expected: Desktop app starts and runs normally. No direct console.* calls remain in non-test, non-logger source files.

tests.name: Desktop typecheck passes
tests.expected: Running 'npm run typecheck' in desktop/ exits 0 with no errors.

tests.name: Desktop vitest all pass
tests.expected: Running 'npx vitest run' in desktop/ exits 0, all tests pass.

tests.name: src-ts typecheck passes
tests.expected: Running 'npm run typecheck' in src-ts/ exits 0 with no errors.

tests.name: src-ts workflow-engine tests pass
tests.expected: Running workflow-engine test suite in src-ts/ exits 0, 34 tests pass.

tests.name: src-ts workflow-engine-adapter tests pass
tests.expected: Running workflow-engine-adapter test in src-ts/ exits 0, 2 tests pass.

tests.name: Workflow engine public API contract is runStream (not run_stream)
tests.expected: publicEntryApi() returns ['route','plan','execute','run','runStream']. No 'run_stream' appears in any .ts file in src-ts/.

tests.name: Evaluation and StoryBible component subdirectories exist and are wired
tests.expected: desktop/src/components/evaluation/ and story-bible/ subdirectories exist. Compatibility re-export anchors (EvaluationPanel.tsx, StoryBiblePanel.tsx) exist and import from subdirectories.

tests.name: i18n modules are split and aggregated
tests.expected: desktop/src/i18n/modules/ contains app/, chat/, evaluation/, mcp/, sidebar/, storybible modules. translations.ts aggregates all module exports.

tests.name: Craft catalog JSON data files exist and load correctly
tests.expected: src-ts/narrative/writing-craft/catalog-data/ contains 6 JSON files. catalog-loader loads them without errors. craft-catalog re-exports all data.

tests.name: Revision orchestrator uses logger (not console) for content evaluation
tests.expected: When revision orchestrator evaluates content, it logs via logger.log/logger.error, not console.log/console.error.
